newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 5.6 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 5.6 bln rupees.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Monday it had auctioned six-month maturity short-term federal bonds worth 5.633 billion rupees, at a weighted average yield of 17.42086 percent per annum.
The bank received bids worth a total of 6.933 billion rupees out of which bids for 5.633 billion rupees were accepted.
In the previous auction held on May 5, bids worth 13.04 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 17.07121 percent per annum.
